node_definition.done_when: Context: the process-global support clip mode (nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py _SUPPORT_CLIP_MODE, set_support_clip_mode and support_clip_mode) is being retired. The certificate hub (benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py, merged 30b49fbe4) and the ten shared helpers (merged dc6010625) now take an additive clip_mode keyword whose default None keeps the prior behaviour, and they thread modes through ForwardFluxOperator.with_clip_mode and ForwardSolveRequest(clip_mode=...). This node migrates these leaf benchmarks: centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt, centroid_field_response_probe, chord_booking_operation_trace, coupling_moment_order_evaluation, empty_exact_polygon_probe, exact_clip_low_state_discriminator, exact_clip_memory_scaling, exact_clip_warm_cost, exact_cut_cell_moment_stages, exact_placement_discriminator, limited_row_shadow_census, limiter_read_resolution_audit. Rules: (a) every set-and-restore of the global becomes explicit threading of that mode to each operator, profile and request the file builds, and to the clip_mode keyword of every hub or helper function it calls, so that no global is set; (b) a receipt that records a mode records the solving operator's mode, never support_clip_mode(); (c) no behaviour change for chord, the default. Gate, logged under the run directory: (1) grep finds no set_support_clip_mode or support_clip_mode in these files; (2) the shared interpreter /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/.venv/bin/python compiles each with py_compile and imports each with its __file__ printed; (3) every test module that imports any of these files, run with JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu and -m 'not slow' in one fresh pytest process per file in place on this fleet allocation, adds no failure against the dispatch base by test id, with baseline_suite and after_suite recording failure_ids and the literal command per module. For the base arm use a git archive of the dispatch base restricted to nova tests benchmarks scripts under /tmp, removed before the manifest is written, and note source_revision failures caused by the missing .git as such. Every uv command carries --no-sync and nothing runs uv sync. The manifest's status is one of complete, blocked or failed.
